scripts.db:init: sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -E -C -i ./Backend/Database/InitTables.sql && sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -E -C -i ./Backend/Database/ReadProcedures.sql && sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -E -C -i ./Backend/Database/WriteProcedures.sql
scripts.dev: npm run db:init && concurrently --names BE,FE --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
